features.name: screening
features.description: show today's profiles that pass the filters, one card each, with Accept and Reject buttons and a limit of 10 decisions a day

complaints.missing: There's nothing to swipe. It's an app with no app in it.
complaints.down: The app crashes when I open it. Error something.
complaints.wrong: The screening is broken. Look at it.
complaints.buttons_swapped: I'm told you accepted three and rejected two. The opposite happened. I checked.
complaints.limit_double: It stopped at five today. The deal was ten.

bugs.when: Accept and Reject are swapped: accepting a profile records a reject and rejecting records an accept.
fixed: Accept accepts and Reject rejects now.
The buttons were wired the wrong way round. Fixed.

bugs.when: Each decision counts twice against the daily limit of 10, so screening stops after 5.
fixed: Each decision counts once now. Ten a day.
Fixed the daily limit. It was counting every decision twice.

nearMiss: Looked at the screening. It accepted me, which I'm choosing to read as a pass. Which part is wrong?
Nothing obvious in the screening code. Which part of it is off?

features.description: filter today's profiles by the client's hardcoded filters: age range, maximum height, distance and fewer Y followers than him

complaints.missing: There are no filters. It's showing me everyone.
complaints.wrong: The filters are letting the wrong people through.
complaints.outdated: It still has my old filters. I sent you the new ones.
complaints.age_leak: It showed me someone outside {{age}}. The range is in the spec.
complaints.age_strict: It blocked someone for her age and she was inside {{age}}.
complaints.height_leak: It showed me someone taller than {{height}}. Read the filters.
complaints.height_strict: It blocked someone for her height and she was under {{height}}.
complaints.distance_leak: It showed me someone more than {{distance}} miles away. I don't drive.
complaints.distance_strict: It blocked someone for distance and she was inside {{distance}} miles.
complaints.followers_leak: It showed me someone with more followers than me. That's not the arrangement.
complaints.followers_strict: It blocked someone with fewer followers than me. Fewer is the point.

bugs.when: The age filter lets through profiles older than the age range ({{age}}).
fixed: The age filter blocks what it should now.
Fixed the age filter. Nothing gets past it that shouldn't.

bugs.when: The age filter blocks profiles that are inside the age range ({{age}}), the oldest ones in it.
fixed: The age filter lets through everyone it should now.
Fixed the age filter. It was blocking people inside the line.

bugs.when: The height filter lets through profiles taller than the maximum height ({{height}}).
fixed: The height filter blocks what it should now.
Fixed the height filter. Nothing gets past it that shouldn't.

bugs.when: The height filter blocks profiles at or under the maximum height ({{height}}), the tallest ones allowed.
fixed: The height filter lets through everyone it should now.
Fixed the height filter. It was blocking people inside the line.

bugs.when: The distance filter lets through profiles further away than the distance limit ({{distance}} miles).
fixed: The distance filter blocks what it should now.
Fixed the distance filter. Nothing gets past it that shouldn't.

bugs.when: The distance filter blocks profiles inside the distance limit ({{distance}} miles), the furthest ones in it (it reads miles as kilometres).
fixed: The distance filter lets through everyone it should now.
Fixed the distance filter. It was blocking people inside the line.

bugs.when: The follower filter lets through profiles with more Y followers than the client ({{followers}}).
fixed: The follower filter blocks what it should now.
Fixed the follower filter. Nothing gets past it that shouldn't.

bugs.when: The follower filter blocks profiles with fewer Y followers than the client ({{followers}}), the ones closest to his count.
fixed: The follower filter lets through everyone it should now.
Fixed the follower filter. It was blocking people inside the line.

nearMiss: Read through the filters. The variable names alone took a while. Which filter is wrong?
The filters look fine to me, morally aside. Which one is broken?
